title: Farstrand - The Undertow
message:
FARSTRAND Herald fight "The Undertow" (Verrin).
F# minor, 150 BPM. Orders 1-6 loop.
The hook is the HELIOBANE Herald motif; the dark section quotes the Verrin cell.
All samples synthesized. Source: songs/farstrand_undertow.gen.js
